bibl.title: Interaction between microbiota and immunity in health and disease

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: the two-way traffic between the commensal microbiota and the mammalian immune system - how microbes train immunity and how immunity in turn shapes which microbes persist
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: which microbiome-immunity interactions are mechanistically established, and what still stands between association and a causal claim in human disease
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a review that organises the mechanisms by compartment and by disease and then states plainly that a direct causal relationship has not been established in most medical conditions - the negative claim is the contribution
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: critique
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: host-microbe mutualism and its breakdown - a relationship in which each side regulates the other, so that neither perturbation nor dysregulation can be read as the cause of the other from observation alone
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a narrative review of germ-free, gnotobiotic, antibiotic-depletion and dietary animal work alongside human association studies, with the review's own scope limits stated - it refers out to other reviews rather than claiming coverage
span.term: a narrative review of germ-free, gnotobiotic, antibiotic-depletion and dietary animal work alongside human association studies, with the review's own scope limits stated - it refers out to other reviews rather than claiming coverage
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the causal claims of this field rest on germ-free animals - raised with no commensals at all. That is the cleanest possible contrast and it is also a state no animal is ever in outside a facility, so what it establishes is that commensals matter, not which ones do what at natural abundance
span.term: an instrument that is an extreme, not a control
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: microbiota drive immune activation and inflammation conversely reshapes the microbial community. When each side changes the other, an observed association in a diseased human carries no direction, which is exactly why the authors say the causal relationship before onset has not been established
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: 16S rRNA sequencing reports genus and composition. Every strain-level and every functional difference in the reviewed literature was therefore not measured rather than not present - and the recommendation to move to shotgun metagenomics is a statement about what the existing corpus of findings could not have seen
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: NLRP6's effect on microbiota structure appears only where the background microbiota contains particular pathobionts such as Helicobacter. A knockout phenotype that depends on the vivarium is a joint property of gene and facility, and two labs reporting different results may both be right
span.term: the phenotype belongs partly to the building
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: faecal microbiome transplantation aims to restore a healthy microbiome configuration, and the authors state there is no general consensus on which features constitute a healthy microbiome. The therapy is specified by its mechanism and not by its endpoint
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a direct causal relationship between the microbiome and immunity before onset or in early disease has not been established in most medical conditions
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the causal effect of the microbiome on immune dysregulation in most human disorders remains to be proven
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the field runs on laboratory mice whose microbiota is divergent from wild animals and humans, limiting translational potential and reproducibility
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: most of the reviewed work used 16S rRNA sequencing, which resolves genus and composition only and cannot see strain-level or functional differences
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: inter-individual variation typically explains more variance in both microbiome and immune response than disease state does
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: there is no general consensus on which features constitute a healthy microbiome, so FMT efficacy in IBD remains under evaluation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the prophylactic and therapeutic efficacy of traditional individual probiotics in promoting human health is limited
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the review does not claim coverage - it states that the evidence cannot be summarised in one review and refers out to others
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: machine learning, proposed for decoding individualised microbiome patterns - a response to inter-individual variance being larger than the disease signal
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: shotgun metagenomic sequencing and the wider multi-omics stack, carried from genomics into immunology to replace a genus-level instrument
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: germ-free animals, raised with no commensal microbes at all, used as the reference state for every claim that a commensal is required for an immune structure
span.note: eliminates: the possibility that the lymphoid and immune defects are produced by something other than the absence of commensals - there are none to confound with · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Th17 cells scored in germ-free mice and again after defined colonisation, with SFB and with other commensals separately
span.note: eliminates: the Th17 population being a fixed host trait - it is absent without microbes and returns on colonisation, so the microbe is doing the work · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: laboratory mice given a wild microbiota, then challenged with influenza virus and with colitis-induced tumorigenesis
span.note: eliminates: the host genotype explaining the difference - the same laboratory animal changes phenotype when only the microbiota is swapped · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: microbiome depletion by broad-spectrum antibiotics in humans, followed by seasonal influenza vaccination and plasma metabolome profiling
span.note: eliminates: reverse causation from immune state to microbiome - here the microbiome was depleted deliberately and the antibody response followed · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: NLRP6-deficient mice compared across vivaria with different background microbiota, rather than in one facility
span.note: eliminates: a gene effect that is really a facility effect - and the comparison shows the phenotype appears ONLY where particular pathobionts are present · outcome: partial
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: integration of multi-omics data sets - metagenomics, single-cell transcriptomics, epigenomics, proteomics and metabolomics - proposed for disentangling the interaction under host genetics and environmental triggers
span.note: eliminates: the direction of the microbiota-immune relationship, which the cited animal evidence shows to be bidirectional - the multi-omics integration that would separate cause from consequence is proposed, not done · outcome: absent-declared-unreported
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: faecal microbiome transplantation in IBD, named as under evaluation with fecal processing and patient safety unresolved
span.note: eliminates: whether restoring the microbiome restores the immune phenotype - named as under evaluation, with faecal processing and patient safety unresolved · outcome: absent-declared-unreported
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
